component.name: S-Shot
component.summary: Lightweight screenshot and annotation tool for Linux

description.p: S-Shot is a native, ultra-lightweight Linux screenshot taking and annotation application with a clean user interface, low memory footprint, system tray integration, and multi-tab image editing.

ul.li: Fullscreen, active window, and custom region screen capture
Color picker tool with hex and rgb clipboard copying
Rich annotation toolset: pen, highlighter, line, arrow, double arrow, rectangle, ellipse, badge counters, and borderless text labels
Area selection tool with move, copy, cut, crop, and white canvas deletion
Canvas expansion handles with pan and hand tool navigation
Pixelate and blur obfuscation tools for sensitive content
Fast startup and minimal system resource usage

description.p: Directional canvas edge reduction and cropping, fixed Backspace and Delete keys inside text boxes during editing, desktop entry deduplication, and viewport boundary synchronization.
Support pasting copied images directly onto the active canvas, white canvas expansion, borderless text boxes, white background on selected area deletion, and full Flathub specification integration.
Canvas expansion background filled with white, borderless text boxes, white background on selected area deletion, and full Flathub specification integration.
Added pan tool, edge resize handles, and improved tool palette feedback.
